candidates.tagline: Golf's first AI commentator arrives — whether golf wanted it or not
candidates.story: The 2026 New Mexico Open (September 14–16) is introducing 'Duff Foreman,' an autonomous AI broadcast personality that will provide live, unscripted golf commentary alongside human hosts for nine hours of YouTube coverage, despite the rollout being 'universally hated and mocked on social media' and the AI's X account consisting of nothing but, per critics, 'pointless AI slop.'
candidates.why_funny: The first AI golf commentator's most impressive credential is a video of itself playing golf from the summit of Mount Everest, and the tournament's official press release quoted a former PGA Tour winner earnestly explaining that the AI would help viewers understand what players are thinking.
candidates.alt: Notah Begay III, former PGA Tour winner and human co-host of the New Mexico Open broadcast, photographed in a TV studio — he will be joined in the booth by AI commentator Duff Foreman for nine hours of live coverage

candidates.tagline: Packard Bell turns 100 and celebrates by pivoting to steam cleaners
candidates.story: Acer relaunched the Packard Bell brand at IFA 2026 to mark its centennial, repositioning the company that helped democratize the beige desktop PC as a 'lifestyle brand' — whose inaugural product line includes a suitcase-style vinyl turntable, audio glasses, a 4G feature phone, and a connected mini-steamer alongside the obligatory laptop.
candidates.why_funny: The brand that spent a century going from consumer radios to color televisions to cheap unreliable PCs has now found its hundred-year destiny: a Wi-Fi-connected clothes steamer.
candidates.alt: The new Packard Bell DotBook laptop displayed alongside the DotLoop suitcase-style vinyl turntable at IFA 2026, representing the brand's relaunch as a lifestyle brand under Acer
